capability.name: EVM signature check for keys and smart wallets (EIP-191/712, ERC-1271/6492)
capability.description: Did this address sign this? Give signer, signature and the message (EIP-191), the typed data (EIP-712, any types) or the digest. A key's 65-byte or EIP-2098 signature is recovered here with no network. A smart wallet's is asked of the chain in one eth_call of the ERC-6492 universal validator (viem's bytecode), which calls the wallet's isValidSignature (ERC-1271) and, for an ERC-6492 wrapped signature, first runs its factory call so a wallet not deployed yet verifies too. Pinned to one block on Base, Base Sepolia or Ethereum; returns valid, the method, the digest, the EIP-712 domain separator and whether the signer had code (or an EIP-7702 delegate). Changes no state.

signer.description: the address that should have signed

message.description: EIP-191 personal message: text, or 0x hex bytes

block.description: block to check at (default: the latest)

note: a smart-wallet signature an x402 seller or an agent can check before trusting it
